summary: This bill amends the PROTECT Our Children Act of 2008 to require the National Strategy for Child Exploitation Prevention and Interdiction to include plans for coordinating with non-profit organizations and higher education institutions on best practices for preventing and responding to crimes against children, and recommendations for law enforcement agencies on these issues.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on strengthening the National Strategy for Child Exploitation Prevention and Interdiction by including coordination with non-profits and universities, and providing recommendations for law enforcement on preventing, identifying, and responding to crimes against children. This directly aims to enhance law enforcement and protective measures for child victims, aligning with stricter justice and stronger policing in this specific area.
